title: spergula rupicola
intro: Spergula rupicola, commonly known as rock spurry, is a type of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. It is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which provide relief from skin irritations and wounds. The health benefits of Spergula rupicola include its ability to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects.
